data.name: Rois.PrescanExplain
data.value: When events are rare (fire, intrusion, missing helmet), heavy models above burn CPU on every frame for nothing. Enable pre-scan: a lightweight model first checks if anything at all is happening. Only when it spots something — heavy models run, and only on a small crop around the candidate, not the whole ROI. Typical savings: 50-80% CPU when events are rare.

data.name: Rois.SensLow

data.name: Rois.SensHigh
data.value: High (15%) — catches more, but more pre-scan false-positives

data.name: Rois.SensExplain
data.value: Low = lower CPU cost, but might miss a small/distant object. High = more heavy-model calls on "maybe-candidates".

data.name: Rois.PrescanPaddingHelp

data.name: Wizard.Help.StepRoi
data.value:
ROI (Region of Interest): • Rectangular sub-area of the frame where the ML model runs. • Full frame = analyse everything. 95% of cases. • Narrow ROI saves CPU/GPU when only part of view is relevant.
Who defines ROIs: IT admin in Advanced → ROI. Pick from existing or use "Full frame".

data.name: Wizard.Help.StepZone
data.value:
Zone (alert polygon): • Polygon inside ROI — alerts fire only when detection falls inside. • "Whole ROI" = simplest, polygon = entire rectangle. • Custom polygon: narrow strip near gate, around machine, excluding footpath.
Not every detection = alert. Add more zones later in Advanced → Zones.

data.value: Will create: 1 camera + 1 ROI + 1 zone + {0} triggers + 1 action.

data.name: Wizard.Help.Step1
data.value:
Who adds cameras: • New cameras (URL, credentials, vendor) are added by IT admin in Advanced → Cameras. • As a safety/BHP operator you only pick from the list.
Tips: • If no cameras show up — request setup from IT. • Click a card to select.

data.name: Wizard.Help.Step2
data.value:
14 built-in safety classes. Click cards to pick.
Tips: • Pick 2-5 classes at start. Easier to tune FP rates later. • For YOLO-World classes (Text) compile prompt pack before first inference (Advanced → Prompt packs).
Pitfalls: • Picking 10+ classes at once makes FP analysis hard.

data.name: Wizard.Help.Step3
data.value:
Currently: scope = full camera frame.
Refine later in /zones — draw polygon zones (e.g. 'only near machine'). Alerts only fire inside zones.

data.name: Wizard.Help.Step4
data.value:
Action = what happens after a rule fires.
Recommendations: • Start with "In-app notification" — operator sees popup, zero config. • Email — add SMTP in /admin/settings. • Webhook — Slack/Teams/ERP. POST JSON.
Each trigger rate-limited to 10 fires/minute by default.

data.name: Wizard.Help.Step5
data.value:
After "Create and run": • Camera + zone + rules saved. • Pipeline starts within ~5 seconds. • Redirect to /flow — graph of what was created.
Next: • /monitor — live detections. • /incidents — alerts. • /admin/triggers — refine thresholds.
